featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

🎂**Konwój Urodzinowy Killer'a** 🎂


📢**Informacje**📢

• Data: 15.11.2026

• Miasto Początkowe: Dover

• Miejsce zbiórki: Parking Obok Portu

• Miasto Końcowe: Wrocław

• Firma Końcowa: Stein Bruch (Kopalnia)

• Ładunek: Do 10 ton

• Ciężarówka: Firmowa + Naczepa (Zestaw)

• Godzina Zbiórki: 19:00 (Czasu Polskiego)

• Godzina Wyjazdu: 20:00 (Czasu Polskiego)

• Na Końcu ustawiamy się bez naczep tak jak Pilot nakaże


📋**Zasady Panujące na Konwoju**📋

• Dystans pomiędzy graczami od 100 do 150 metrów

• Nie przekrzykiwania Pilotów (Jeżeli Pilot coś mówi prosimy o ciszę gdyż podaje ważną informacje)

• Prędkość Miasto 60km/h

• Prędkość Landówki: 70km/h (proste odcinki max 80km/h)

• Prędkość Ekspresówki i autostrady: 80km/h (Wyjątek jak konwój jest zbity to zwiększymy do 90km/h

• Zakaz wyprzedzania (Chyba że Pilot pozwoli)(Nie Dotyczy Pojazdów Eskorty konwoju oraz wspierających konwój Game Moderatorów)

• Obowiązek kulturalnego zachowania wobec innych uczestników konwoju i użytkowników drogi

• Osoby utrudniające konwój mogą zostać ukarane poprzez wykluczenie (czasowe wycofanie z konwoju lub permanętne)

• Zakaz zatrzymywania konwoju bez wyraźnego powodu (np. awarii, problemu technicznego)

• Uczestnicy muszą być gotowi na zmiany trasy lub przerwy wynikające z potrzeb organizatora lub sytuacji na drodze

• Zakaz poruszania się pojazdem typu Scout Extra_D, Scout Extra_D Estate, Public Alternating Vehicle, Patron Alternating Vehicle

• Pojazd Pilota to Scout Extra_D oraz Scout Extra_D Estate w malowaniu Pilota i posiadający Player Tag "PILOT | WładcY SzoS"

• Obowiązują również Zasady panujące na serwerach TruckersMP

• Nieznajomość Regulaminu nie zwalnia z jego przestrzegania

• Niezastosowanie się do Regulaminu oznacza brak szacunku do firmy Organizującej Konwój

* Starting Location : Elko (Slots) 
* Ending Location: Lake Havasu City - Coastline Mining

upcoming.name: BVAR Trucking November Remembrance Convoy
upcoming.description:
![](https://images.pixieset.com/798473001/8cab5b08face561d90902d672b95992f-xxlarge.png)

### You're invited to join BVAR Trucking November  Rememberance Month convoy.

### Come join us on a scenic tour around the stunning and majestic country of Romania and a brief look around the northern cities of Bulgaria. Your going to be starting off in Bulgaria in the city of **Ruse** taking us west towards **Pleven** and **Kozloduy** before heading northbound into Romania . Here you will be heading north towards **Craiova** continuing the north bound route towards **Hunedoara** where fun and scenic roads will take your eyes. We will be continuing the convoy north east towards **Targu Mures** following the *15* road round onto the *28a*, *28*, *2* and the *11* through **Bacau**, **Brasov** taking us onto the *73* to our final destination of **Pitesti**. 

*While on route you may see many graveyards & churches. As the convoy is in the month of November we will be honouring the fallen and marks the end of WWI On 11th November 1918. So If you see a graveyard feel free to show your respects by giving a little "beep beep"* | *Feel free to use Red/Black into your skin if you wish to as BVAR will be rolling in these colours for the convoy* |

🚛 Monthly Convoy Rules

To ensure an organized, enjoyable, and safe monthly convoy for everyone, all participants are required to follow these rules:

📋 General Rules

1. Fully respect the scheduled meeting and departure time.
2. Arrive at the meeting point early enough before departure.
3. Follow the designated route and do not change the route without staff permission.
4. Reckless driving and random overtaking are not allowed.
5. Maintain a safe distance between trucks.
6. Intentional collisions or blocking other convoy members are strictly prohibited.
7. Follow the instructions of the Convoy Leader and Staff throughout the convoy.
8. Do not use horns or lights excessively or in a disturbing manner.
9. If you experience a technical problem, inform the staff and avoid stopping suddenly on the road.
10. Respect all participants and maintain good behavior.

🚨 Violations & Punishments

* Minor violation: Warning.
* Repeated violation: Official warning.
* Serious or intentional violations may result in removal from the convoy or a ban from future events.
* Creating problems, provoking others, or disrupting the convoy is prohibited.

🏁 During the Convoy

* Maintain the convoy formation whenever possible.
* Do not overtake the Convoy Leader unless instructed by the staff.
* If you lose contact with the convoy, contact a staff member and wait for instructions.
* The purpose of the convoy is fun, organization, and teamwork.

We wish everyone a safe and enjoyable convoy. Following the rules is every participant’s responsibility. 🚛🤍

upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:
The Event Staff are recognized as:  “NextGen | PM, NextGen | ES, NextGen | CC, NextGen | Lead, NextGen | Tail, NextGen | GM or similar.
Free roaming is prohibited.
Participants must haul a trailer.
Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
Overtaking is prohibited.
Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:
Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

upcoming.name: Anna's Birthday Ride with Trucker Pepa
upcoming.description:
Hello everyone, after long time i am back with another convoy. This time again kinda smaller one and this time we gonna again celebrate birthday of my Friend Anna. I know that she became kinda less popular than she was before even that it doesnt gonna stop me to make a small convoy. As our friend relationship get kinda neutral, we dont need to have big convoy to remind this tradition. Couse everyone know its not a trend its a tradition :D. This time we gonna go driving in Scandinavia as my favorite DLC in game. WE will go from Esbjerg to Uppsala, the route will have around 1058km/657miles. I hope we gonna enjoy this special day again together. Looking forward to see you all here. Cyaa on the road.

Trucker Pepa

Meetup place: Esbjerg (Container Port)
Destination: Uppsala ( Dekkar Trans)
Meetup Time: 15:00 UTC/16:00 CET
Departure time: 16:00 UTC/17:00 CET

upcoming.rule:
## Rules for Participants
* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Need | CC, GM, Staff or Similar."
* Impersonating Event Staff using the tags mentioned above is forbidden.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers, and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars and Bus are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Overtaking is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. You must park in the 'Public Parking' area if you don't have a designated slot.
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one-by-one) manner.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

## Event Rules for Event Staff
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. Following the rule above.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
